Enum Class PlanetDataLayer

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PlanetDataLayer>
org.ether.society.procedural.PlanetDataLayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PlanetDataLayer>, Constable
public enum PlanetDataLayer extends Enum<PlanetDataLayer>
Types of data layers that can be loaded/generated for a planet. Each layer can exist at multiple resolutions.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • ELEVATION

      public static final PlanetDataLayer ELEVATION
      Elevation data (meters above/below sea level). Sources: ETOPO1, SRTM, procedural generation.

    • BIOME

      public static final PlanetDataLayer BIOME
      Biome classification (forest, desert, tundra, etc.). Sources: WWF Ecoregions, procedural based on climate.

    • UNDERGROUND_RESOURCES

      public static final PlanetDataLayer UNDERGROUND_RESOURCES
      Underground resource deposits (ores, coal, oil). Sources: USGS MRDS, procedural.

    • FRESHWATER

      public static final PlanetDataLayer FRESHWATER
      Fresh water availability (rivers, lakes, aquifers). Scale: 0 = desert, 1 = abundant.

    • SEA_TEMPERATURE

      public static final PlanetDataLayer SEA_TEMPERATURE
      Sea surface temperature for ocean cells.
